Blossom Carousel Core 1.1.9, installed from `@blossom-carousel/core`.

These browser-ready assets are committed because the site serves static files
without a JavaScript bundler. The script includes `@bramus/style-observer`;
both MIT licenses are included here.

After updating the dependency, run `npm run vendor:carousel` and commit the
refreshed assets together with `package.json` and `package-lock.json`.

Documentation: https://blossom-carousel.com/docs/framework-guides/core
